commands: ls -la .aidd/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No .aidd directory in current working directory"
for f in .aidd/features/*/feature.json; do echo "=== $(basename $(dirname $f)) ==="; cat "$f" | head -5; echo "---"; done

for dir in .aidd/features/*/; do
  name=$(basename "$dir")
  status=$(cat "$dir/feature.json" | grep -o '"status"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -1)
  passes=$(cat "$dir/feature.json" | grep -o '"passes"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[a-z]*' | head -1)
  spernakit=$(cat "$dir/feature.json" | grep -o '"spernakit_version"' | head -1)
  echo "$name | $status | $passes | template: $spernakit"
done

for dir in .aidd/features/*/; do
  name=$(basename "$dir")
  echo "=== $name ==="
  cat ".aidd/features/$name/feature.json"
  echo ""
  echo "---"
done 2>&1 | head -3000

basename() { echo "${1##*/}"; }
for dir in .aidd/features/*/; do
  name="${dir%/}"
  name="${name##*/}"
  echo "=== $name ==="
  cat ".aidd/features/$name/feature.json"

done 2>&1 | head -5000
find .aidd/features -name feature.json -exec sh -c 'echo "=== $(echo {} | cut -d/ -f3) ===" && cat {} && echo ""' \;

find .aidd/features -name feature.json | while read f; do
  name=$(echo "$f" | cut -d/ -f3)
  status=$(grep '"status"' "$f" | head -1 | sed 's/.*:.*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
  passes=$(grep '"passes"' "$f" | head -1 | sed 's/.*:.*\([a-z]*\).*/\1/')
  echo "$name | status=$status | passes=$passes"
done

for name in api-key-management app-branding-config audit-log-viewer authentication-rbac backup-administration bug-report-intake business-metrics-analytics cost-catalog-management custom-dashboard-management file-upload-management health-monitoring margin-data-schema notifications-websocket pricing-calculation-engine pricing-dashboard quote-scenario-api risk-flagging scenario-comparison scenario-editor scenario-export-summary scenario-fixed-costs scenario-labor-modeling scenario-line-items scenario-list-page scheduler-administration seed-quote-data settings-administration user-management workspace-management; do

  passes=$(grep '"passes"' ".aidd/features/$name/feature.json" | head -1 | sed 's/.*: \(.*\)$/\1/')
  echo "$name | $status | $passes"
done
find .aidd/features -name feature.json -print0 | xargs -0 -I{} sh -c 'echo "$(basename $(dirname {})): $(grep status {} | head -1 | tr -d "[:space:],")"'

find .aidd/features -name feature.json > feature_list.txt
wc -l feature_list.txt
head -5 feature_list.txt

while IFS= read -r fpath; do
  name=$(echo "$fpath" | cut -d/ -f3)
  status=$(grep '"status"' "$fpath" | head -1 | sed 's/[[:space:]]*"status"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
  passes=$(grep '"passes"' "$fpath" | head -1 | sed 's/[[:space:]]*"passes"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\([a-z]*\).*/\1/')
  echo "$name|$status|$passes"
done < feature_list.txt

firstline=$(head -1 feature_list.txt)
echo "LINE: [$firstline]"
echo "EXISTS: $(test -f "$firstline" && echo yes || echo no)"
read fpath < feature_list.txt && echo "[$fpath]" && test -f "$fpath" && echo EXISTS
